authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)

symbols.name: FSSAI Vegetarian Logo
symbols.notes: Under FSSAI definitions, honey, beeswax, and dairy products are permitted under the vegetarian classification.
symbols.placement: Principal Display Panel near brand name
symbols.svgSnippet: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24"><rect x="2" y="2" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2" rx="2"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="6" fill="#15803d"/></svg>

symbols.name: FSSAI Non-Vegetarian Logo
symbols.notes: Mandatory for food containing whole or part of any animal including birds, marine animals, or eggs.
symbols.placement: Principal Display Panel near brand name
symbols.svgSnippet: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24"><rect x="2" y="2" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="2" rx="2"/><polygon points="12,6 18,18 6,18" fill="#78350f"/></svg>

symbols.name: FSSAI Statutory Vegan Food Logo
symbols.notes: Statutory FSSAI Vegan Logo requires prior FSSAI registration/endorsement. Disallows animal-derived ingredients including honey.
symbols.placement: Principal Display Panel contiguous to name of food
